title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Karachi. Tip #1
body: Get into IBA, or get into a private university and say "IBA was my backup anyway." If you hear "Papa's factory is in Korangi," "our office is on Chundrigar," or "we're in shipping," you're getting warmer. Karachi money is trading money and it never states a number. Then ask where they live. If they answer "Bath Island" or "Block 4" and stop, no landmark, no explanation, you're extremely warm. It's a sealed deal if the family surname is also the name of a building on Shahrah-e-Faisal.

title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Karachi. Tip #2

If they say "I did my A Levels" and never name it, that's someone assuming you already know. It's a sealed deal when two strangers discover a shared section from 2012 and the whole table rearranges itself.

title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Karachi. Tip #3
body: Ask about the hut, not the house. French Beach, in the family since before the road was decent, described as falling apart with real affection. New money has a farmhouse past the toll plaza with a pool. Old Karachi has a hut with no electricity and a generator someone's father bought in 1998. It's a sealed deal if a weekend there needs no planning because everybody already knows.

title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Karachi. Tip #5

It's a sealed deal if a grown adult there cannot tell you what a tanker costs.

title: How to (Accidentally) Meet Your Rich 🚩 Spouse in Karachi. Tip #7

The real one is an old flat in Bath Island, high ceilings, bad plumbing, art nobody explains. No posts, no highlights, a surname that changes how a waiter at Okra stands. It's a sealed deal if they fix everything with one phone call and think that's normal.
